hooks.command: input=$(cat); file=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); if [[ "$file" == */config.php ]] && [[ "$file" != */.docker/config.php ]]; then echo 'BLOCK: config.php contiene credenciales de BD. Para la plantilla usa .docker/config.php'; exit 1; fi
input=$(cat); file=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); if [[ "$file" == *.php ]] && [ -f vendor/bin/phpcbf ]; then vendor/bin/phpcbf "$file" 2>/dev/null || true; fi
